verdict.rationale: LangGraph ships as a pip-installable Python library with a CLI (`langgraph dev`, `langgraph deploy`) and production-grade persistence (Postgres checkpointers), all of which support running the graph programmatically/headlessly outside any UI, and the GitHub docs emphasize durable, long-running, failure-resistant execution suited to automated pipelines. However, there is no explicit CI/CD documentation, example GitHub Actions workflow, or headless test-harness guidance in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs/examples, headless test guidance, and independent confirmation of CI usage.
